serviceIdentification.serviceDescription:
The Armory is a purpose-built General Support System (GSS) cloud service offering (CSO) that delivers security and compliance services aligned to the FedRAMP Class D (High) Rev. 5 risk categorization baseline. The Armory accelerates the ability for Independent Software Vendors (ISVs) and Enterprises to meet complex regulatory requirements on the Google Cloud Platform (GCP). The Armory delivers and continuously monitors FedRAMP compliant, risk-mitigated cloud solutions to government agencies and their partners through either a hosted or managed delivery model by:

- providing full compliance architecture, engineering, documentation and audit support,

- reducing the burden to both agencies and SaaS providers,

- expanding the catalog of mission-critical cloud solutions available to agencies.

The Armory is built on the FedRAMP authorized Assured Workloads Google Cloud Platform and includes configuration managed Google resources such as VPCs (Virtual Private Clouds), networking components, security controls, identity and access management (IAM) policies, and logging and monitoring mechanisms. The system also provides access to in-boundary tools for automation, configuration management, and account management. Each of these mechanisms has been configured to meet specific regulatory requirements such as International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR), FedRAMP Class D (High) Rev. 5, and Department of Defense (DoD) Impact Levels 4/5 (IL 4/5).

The Armory provides ISVs, Enterprises and Agencies with access to pre-production staging environments and Google “Landing Zones”. These are securely architected environments that enable quick and compliant deployments, and a scalable foundation for their regulated cloud workloads. This secure standardized approach to creating and managing deployments allows government agencies and customers to easily deploy and manage their workloads while maintaining security, governance, and compliance.

**ISV Partners:**

- **Qanapi** - As our inaugural ISV Partner, Qanapi’s FIPS-validated API service delivers state-of-the-art encryption and protection at the data level. Designed to safeguard sensitive, industry-regulated, and mission-critical data, Qanapi’s API seamlessly integrates into any software, device, or network. Built on a zero-trust architecture, it ensures robust security across organizations of all sizes, in both the public and commercial sectors. With Qanapi, organizations can achieve the highest level of data protection and compliance, regardless of their environment. Discover more at Quantum-Safe Data Security Platform | Qanapi - https://www.qanapi.com/
- **MxDR for Government** – Accenture Federal Services' MxDR for Government is a managed security service designed specifically for federal agencies. Powered by Google SecOps, it offers 24/7 continuous threat detection, automated response, and threat-centric case management to help agencies rapidly neutralize cyber threats while maintaining strict regulatory compliance. Discover more at: MxDR for Government | Accenture - https://www.accenture.com/us-en/industries/accenture-federal-services/cybersecurity/mxdr-government
- **Armory SecOps** - provides Google SecOps capabilities, security monitoring, detection engineering, triage, investigation support, dashboarding, and response workflow support for federal workloads that consume security operations services through The Armory.

overallSummaryOfAssessment.summary: Emagine IT supplied the overall summary for the initial FedRAMP assessment of The Armory, a FedRAMP Class D (High) Rev. 5 baseline system. The assessment began on 2026-01-05 and ended on 2026-07-08. Emagine IT reported that 100% of the FedRAMP security controls in the system baseline were assessed, with assessed controls listed in Appendix A of the Security Assessment Plan. The assessor evaluated the associated control selections, reviewed and/or tested continuous monitoring activities as necessary, evaluated open POA&M items including vendor dependencies, validated POA&M closures, and confirmed the continued relevance and applicability of documented false positives, risk adjustments, and operational requirements. At the conclusion of the assessment, the SAR Appendix A Risk Exposure Table recorded 15 open risks: 0 high, 4 moderate, 1 moderate risk-adjusted to low, and 10 low.

certifiedServices.serviceDescription: FedRAMP Class D (High) Rev. 5 GSS and SaaS platform that provides common security, compliance, networking, identity, vulnerability management, monitoring, incident response, compliance reporting, and secure landing zone capabilities for hosted and managed government workloads.

Dedicated landing zones for ISV SaaS offerings deployed within The Armory authorization boundary. Hosted services are operated by the Armory team, documented in the Armory SSP, configuration controlled, continuously monitored, and assessed through the authorization or significant change process as applicable.

Secure Google Cloud landing zones for customers that maintain their own authorization boundary while leveraging Armory GSS instrumentation, deployment, and security services to support FedRAMP control implementation responsibilities.
Qanapi is a hosted tenant service within The Armory boundary that runs a containerized Laravel application on Cloud Run with a MySQL Cloud SQL backend and tenant-specific supporting components.

Armory SecOps - SOC-as-a-Service is a hosted tenant service within The Armory boundary that supports SIEM reconciliation, inventory, and Bindplane management capabilities across documented Google Cloud regions.
Accenture Federal Services MxDR is a hosted tenant service within The Armory boundary that operates MxDR management capabilities in the AFS-BAS production project.

certified.useCase: Google Services provides the FedRAMP-authorized IaaS/PaaS foundation and underlying infrastructure for The Armory.
Okta IDaaS Government High Cloud provides SSO and adaptive MFA for privileged infrastructure users.
GovSlack provides operations notifications and alerts for privileged infrastructure users.
CloudFlare for Government provides 443 request forwarding and TLS proxy services for the Qanapi application.
AWS GovCloud Simple Email Service provides transactional email for non-sensitive Qanapi account information.
Box Enterprise Cloud Content Collaboration Platform supports authorization package collaboration and documentation access workflows.
SentinelOne Singularity Platform High provides endpoint security telemetry, endpoint detection and response, and workload protection alerting.
